hints.title: Include or leave out
hints.body: For each position, decide whether to include it. Including a value reduces the remaining target, and the next decision must start at a later index because positions cannot be reused.

hints.title: Sort to spot repeated branches
hints.body: Sorting groups equal values. At one decision level, picking a value equal to the previous value recreates a combination already produced by the earlier branch.

hints.title: Finish and prune
hints.body: Record the path when the remaining target reaches zero. Since all values are positive and sorted, stop the loop as soon as the current value is larger than the remaining target.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
sort candidates
result = []
path = []

explore(start, remaining):
    if remaining == 0:
        result.push(copy of path)
        return

    for i from start to candidates.length - 1:
        if i > start and candidates[i] == candidates[i - 1]:
            continue
        if candidates[i] > remaining:
            break
        path.push(candidates[i])
        explore(i + 1, remaining - candidates[i])
        path.pop()

explore(0, target)
return result
```
